title: Article 48 — Organisation of agriculture and animal husbandry

content.overview: Article 48 directs the State to endeavour to organise agriculture and animal husbandry on modern and scientific lines and, in particular, to take steps for preserving and improving the breeds, and prohibiting the slaughter, of cows and calves and other milch and draught cattle.
content.glance: Organise agriculture and animal husbandry on modern and scientific lines; preserve and improve breeds; prohibit slaughter of cows, calves and other milch and draught cattle.
content.study:
Article 48 combines modernisation of agriculture and animal husbandry with a specific directive on preservation of breeds and prohibition of slaughter of cows, calves and other milch and draught cattle. State laws on cattle slaughter are often linked to this directive and related entries in the Seventh Schedule.

Examination: modern and scientific lines; breed preservation; slaughter prohibition for specified cattle.

sections.heading: Key directive
sections.body: Organise agriculture and animal husbandry on modern and scientific lines; preserve and improve breeds; prohibit slaughter of cows and calves and other milch and draught cattle.
